## Checklist

- [ ] The title follows [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/), because it becomes the commit message on `main`
- [ ] `uv run pytest`, `uv run ruff check`, `uv run ruff format --check` and `uv run mypy` pass
- [ ] New behavior has tests, and bug fixes have a regression test
- [ ] The README is updated if behavior changed, and still claims nothing that doesn't work yet
- [ ] No new runtime dependencies
